title: WildmatError::AllNegation conflates two distinct error cases
description: WildmatError::AllNegation is returned by GroupFilter::new for two distinct situations: (1) the input slice is empty, and (2) the input slice is non-empty but every pattern is negated. The test names groupfilter_empty_list_rejected and groupfilter_all_negation_rejected correctly distinguish these cases, but the error type does not. A caller catching WildmatError cannot distinguish 'no patterns provided' from 'patterns provided but all are negations', which are different configuration mistakes requiring different remediation messages. Splitting into WildmatError::EmptyFilter and WildmatError::AllNegation (or adding a description to the variant) would let error reporting give the operator a more specific message.
